social.text: One take, no cuts 🎬 A oner is an entire scene filmed as a single continuous shot. It’s also called a long take or continuous take, though a oner usually means the shot is the whole scene. It takes choreographed blocking for actors and camera, heavy rehearsal, and cues for focus, lighting and sound. One mistake means starting over. A true one-take has no cuts. A “fake” one hides them. # Filmmaking # Cinematography # OneTake # LongTake # Blocking
